newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia puts British Gas field reserves at 28 bcm.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia puts British Gas field reserves at 28 bcm.

text.p: Tunisian Industry Minister on Thursday said reserves at a new gas field operated by British Gas were estimated at around 28 billion cubic metre (bcm).

"The Hasdrubal field reserves were at first estimated at the half of that of the Miskar field, but the latest evaluation showed that it was the same than of Miskar," Slaheddine Bouguerra told the parliament.
The offshore Miskar field, also operated by British Gas, has a 28.3 billion cubic metre estimated reserves and went on production earlier this year.
The new offshore Hasdrubal field is located in the Gulf of Gabes.
"The quality of the Hasdrubal field is better than that of Miskar," Bouguerra said.
